Fetch Form Submissions.description: Fetches new submissions of one form from the CHT changes feed and posts each to another URL.

Read Changes Feed.description: Reads the CouchDB changes feed with full documents, picking up from the last run.

Fetch Specific Documents.description: Reads the changes feed for specific documents, e.g. a set of contacts.

Get Reports for One Form.description: Reads the changes feed and keeps only the reports for one form.
